title: Chapter 1313 - 1: Yin-Yang Twin Life Flower

Chapter 1313 - 1: Yin-Yang Twin Life Flower

Chapter 1313: Chapter 1: Yin-Yang Twin Life Flower

The Yin-Yang Flower is not of much use to other thirteenth-order time life-forms on different paths.

Therefore, it hasn’t attracted the attention of the thirteenth-order time life-forms. In the timelines observed by Lin Yuan, his avatars always successfully acquired the Yin-Yang Flower.

Of course, observing just a few timelines doesn’t guarantee that he will definitely acquire the Yin-Yang Flower, but the hope is certainly high, and there is no interference from other thirteenth-order time life-forms.

"This is the method of time life-forms..."

Lin Yuan couldn’t help but feel emotional. The most powerful aspect of time life-forms is their ability to choose the future that is most beneficial to them.

For example, without the means to glimpse the future, Lin Yuan estimated that he would not have any chance to come into contact with such a rare treasure as the Yin-Yang Flower before reaching the thirteenth order.

Relying on the ability to glimpse the future, Lin Yuan was able to find a way to achieve the third level of the Chaotic Taiji Dao before the thirteenth order, thereby choosing the future most beneficial to himself.

"The timelines I currently glimpse are still very short. True time life-forms often glimpse timelines millions or even tens of millions of Cosmic Eras ahead. Such arrangements are truly terrifying."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

He also slightly realized the way time life-forms contend with each other.

Perhaps two time life-forms that suddenly engage in battle didn’t have much grievance before the fight.

But they have great karma in the future, so they strike first to clear obstacles.

...

Beyond the Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared here.

"To ensure everything goes smoothly, I’ve even sent out the Taiji Primordial Spirit." Lin Yuan thought, "In those few future timelines, I only sent avatars to successfully acquire the Yin-Yang Flower. Now with the Taiji Primordial Spirit involved, it should be more secure."

This is also Lin Yuan’s emphasis on the Yin-Yang Flower, as anything could happen in the mysterious dimensional gap, and thus he must make thorough preparations.

"In that direction..."

Lin Yuan looked towards a certain direction and set off immediately.

In the future timeline, he discovered the Yin-Yang Flower after tens of thousands of years post entering the thirteenth order, during a casual stroll.

In fact, the location of the Yin-Yang Flower is not far from the Chaos Void. With the traveling speed of Lin Yuan’s Taiji Primordial Spirit, it would take about several hundred to a thousand years to get there.

A round trip would take at most just a few thousand years.

Enough time to return to the Chaos Void before Lin Yuan’s breakthrough.

...

While traveling, Lin Yuan naturally also meditated on the essence of the dimensional gap.

Previously, Lin Yuan’s exploration of the dimensional gap was mostly limited to the surroundings of the Chaos Void.

But now, he needed to travel a certain distance away from the Chaos Void. Having lost the influence of the Chaos Void, the feeling the dimensional gap gives Lin Yuan is naturally different.

The mysterious dimensional gap, like a colossal dimensional space such as the Chaos Void, naturally radiates influence on its surroundings.

However, as Lin Yuan quickly distanced himself from the Chaos Void, this radiation influence gradually decreased, presenting the truest side of the mysterious dimensional gap to Lin Yuan.

"Dimensional gap..."

Lin Yuan felt the vast emptiness of the dimensional gap.

Indeed.

The feeling the dimensional gap gave Lin Yuan was emptiness.

Devoid of anything.

Eternally silent.

In the Chaos Void, there are numerous fluctuations of great Dao rules.

But the dimensional gap has none; there are no fluctuations of great Dao rules.

Therefore, for life born in the dimensional gap, cultivation is an extremely difficult matter.

Because they cannot sense any concrete fluctuations of great Dao rules, equivalent to having no guidance, cultivation relies entirely on oneself.

In such an environment, it’s practically a nightmare for cultivation evolution.

But likewise.

If one can grow up in such an environment.

Then they would definitely be extremely powerful, far surpassing the limits of life within dimensional spaces like the Chaos Void.

Compared to the environment of the dimensional gap, the Chaos Void is almost like a greenhouse.

"However, without the guidance of complete great Dao rules, while the battle power of life in the dimensional gap is indeed extremely powerful, the probability of ultimately becoming a time life-form is very, very low."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Power and realm are not directly related to the comprehension of great Dao rules.

And without a stable environment like dimensional space, many means that help in overcoming the time loop are basically useless.

For example, propagating one’s evolutionary path?

The life in the dimensional gap lives precariously; attempting to propagate one’s evolutionary path here? It is estimated that if one propagates in the morning, the life trying to cultivate in the evening might already fall and perish.

Thus.

The thirteenth-order time life-forms known to Lin Yuan are mostly from some dimensional space, not from the competitively harsh dimensional gap.

...

During the journey.

Lin Yuan also discovered some life-forms in the dimensional gap.

These life-forms are extremely powerful, far surpassing the supreme Great Saints of the Chaos Void, even beyond ordinary Invincible Great Saints.

Yet they are extremely cautious, trying to conceal their own presence as much as possible.

In the dimensional gap, there are only two scenarios for recklessly releasing one’s presence.

One is madness, courting death.

Another is a thirteenth-order time life-form.

Even in as harsh an environment as the dimensional gap, a thirteenth-order time life-form can easily roam.

Buzz~ Lin Yuan’s mind slightly moved, a cosmic field enveloped around him, putting all life-forms within its range in the dimensional gap into a brief slumber, with their memories being silently copied by Lin Yuan.

So far, Lin Yuan knows little about the intelligence and information beyond the Chaos Void in the dimensional gap.

"According to the memories of these life-forms in the dimensional gap, it’s best to avoid the nearby area where the Chaos Void is located." Lin Yuan showed a thoughtful expression.

The Chaos Void is a vast dimensional space nurturing multiple time life-forms, equivalent to the territorial range of time life-forms, and naturally, it is considered taboo for the indigenous life-forms of the dimensional gap.

The reason the Magic Origin Fruit Tree dares to approach the Chaos Void is because it needs to absorb the aura of law and reason emitted by the Chaos Void. It’s already taking some risks in doing that.

"Besides the Chaos Void, there are a few other places that absolutely must not be approached..."

Lin Yuan silently remembered the locations from the memories of these native life-forms in the dimensional gap, speculating that they should be related to time life-forms.

As vast dimensional spaces like the Chaos Void eventually undergo great destruction, what happens to the time life-forms within them then?

They can only leave the Chaos Void and reside permanently in the dimensional gap.

After the great destruction, even if the Chaos Void re-evolves to birth anew, external time life-forms won’t be able to enter.

And for time life-forms, a vast dimensional space like the Chaos Void is akin to a home base, naturally not something they want to lose.

Therefore, the thirteenth-order ones opened up several special places to address the hidden dangers and shortcomings of the Chaos Void, extending the time duration the Chaos Void can last.

Time slowly passed by.

In a blink of an eye, several decades had passed.

With Lin Yuan’s travel speed, the distance covered in several decades is unbelievably vast, now incredibly far from the Chaos Void.

"Still unable to sense the first Source World, the position of the second Source World..." Lin Yuan looked up at the boundless dimensional gap.

He has his true body stationed in both the first Source World and the second Source World. Logically, no matter how far apart, he should be able to sense them. Yet, his perception of his true body in the two Source Worlds still relies solely on the Myriad Realms Gate.

"Perhaps the positions of these two Source Worlds are rather special, capable of isolating the senses?"

Lin Yuan speculated in his mind but didn’t pay it too much attention.

The more mysterious the Source Worlds are, the more it proves that the coordinates of the remaining thirty-one Source Worlds of the Myriad Realms Gate in his mind are extremely rare.

For time life-forms, any powerful dimensional space is extremely precious, especially the Source Worlds, where even the Lord of Heaven Light is willing to pay a steep price to merge into a Source World, hoping to use that perfect aura to impact the final step.

Just as Lin Yuan continued towards the position of the Yin-Yang Flower, his expression suddenly changed as he looked in another direction.

"What is that?"
